How to play

Find the fastest subway route from A to B. The daily journey resets at midnight in New York. Play unlimited journeys in practice.

  1. Tap the trains you would take, in order.You don’t need to choose transfer stations.
  2. Tap “Check route.”
  3. See how you did!Compare your route with the fastest route.
